statement.p: Let \Phi(u,v)=(7u+v,4u+6v) be a map from the uv-plane to the xy-plane.
Describe the image of the line v=4u under \Phi in slope-intercept form.

static.solution:
v=4u, for example ( u,v )=( 1,4 ) and ( u,v )=( 0,0 ). By a property of linear maps,
the image of the line v=4u under the linear map \Phi ( u,v )=( 7u+v,4u+6v ) is the line in the xy-plane through the points \Phi ( 1,4 ) and \Phi ( 0,0 ).
We find these points: \Phi ( 0,0 )=( 7\cdot 0+1\cdot 0,4\cdot 0+6\cdot 0 )=( 0,0 ) \Phi ( 1,4 )=( 7\cdot 1+1\cdot 4,4\cdot 1+6\cdot 4 )=( 11,28 ) We now find the slope-intercept equation of the line in the xy-plane through the points ( 0,0 ) and ( 11,28 ): y-0=\frac{28-0}{11-0}( x-0 )\quad\Rightarrow\quad y=\frac{28}{11}x
